title: Awesome Oscillator Strategy (Bill Williams)
original_description: The Awesome Oscillator (AO) is part of Bill Williams' trading system and measures market momentum by calculating the difference between 5-period and 34-period simple moving averages of median prices. It identifies momentum shifts before they appear in price action.
description_zh: 神奇振荡器（AO）是比尔·威廉姆斯交易系统的一部分，通过计算中间价的 5 周期与 34 周期简单移动平均线之差来衡量市场动量。作者称其能够在价格走势出现变化之前识别动量变化。

title: CCI (Commodity Channel Index) Strategy
original_description: The Commodity Channel Index measures the deviation of price from its statistical mean. Originally developed for commodities, CCI works well across all markets to identify cyclical trends and overbought/oversold conditions.
description_zh: 商品通道指数衡量价格偏离其统计均值的程度。该指标最初为商品市场开发，作者认为它适用于各类市场，可用于识别周期性趋势和超买、超卖状态。

title: Chaikin Oscillator Strategy
original_description: The Chaikin Oscillator measures the momentum of the Accumulation/Distribution line using the difference between fast and slow EMAs. It identifies the flow of volume into or out of an asset, helping traders spot accumulation and distribution phases.
description_zh: 蔡金振荡器通过快慢指数移动平均线之差衡量累积/派发线的动量，用于识别资产成交量的流入或流出，帮助观察吸筹和派发阶段。

title: MFI (Money Flow Index) Strategy
original_description: The Money Flow Index is a volume-weighted momentum indicator that identifies overbought and oversold conditions. Often called "volume-weighted RSI," MFI incorporates both price and volume to detect the strength of money flowing in and out of an asset.
description_zh: 资金流量指数是一个成交量加权的动量指标，用来识别超买和超卖状态。它常被称为“成交量加权 RSI”，结合价格和成交量来衡量资金流入和流出的强度。

title: Momentum Combo Strategy
original_description: The Momentum Combo Strategy combines four powerful momentum indicators (RSI, MACD, Stochastic RSI, and Rate of Change) to generate high-probability signals through confluence. Trades are only taken when multiple indicators agree, significantly reducing false signals.
description_zh: 组合动量策略结合 RSI、MACD、随机 RSI 和变化率四种动量指标，通过多指标汇合生成信号。作者称，只有多个指标一致时才交易，以减少错误信号。

title: RSI Divergence Strategy
original_description: This strategy identifies bullish and bearish divergences between price action and the Relative Strength Index (RSI). Divergences occur when price and momentum indicators move in opposite directions, often signaling potential trend reversals.
description_zh: 此策略识别价格走势与相对强弱指数（RSI）之间的看涨和看跌背离。背离是指价格与动量指标向相反方向运动，通常提示潜在的趋势反转。

title: Stochastic RSI Crossover Strategy
title_zh: 随机 RSI 交叉策略
original_description: The Stochastic RSI combines the Stochastic Oscillator with the RSI to identify overbought and oversold conditions with greater sensitivity. This strategy trades crossovers of the %K and %D lines in extreme zones.
description_zh: 随机 RSI 将随机振荡器与 RSI 结合，以较高敏感度识别超买和超卖状态。此策略在极端区域交易 %K 和 %D 线的交叉。

title: TSI (True Strength Index) Strategy
original_description: The True Strength Index is a double-smoothed momentum oscillator that shows both trend direction and momentum strength. TSI reduces noise through its double smoothing technique while maintaining sensitivity to significant price changes.
description_zh: 真实强度指数是一种双重平滑动量振荡器，同时显示趋势方向和动量强度。TSI 使用双重平滑降低噪声，同时保持对显著价格变化的敏感性。

title: Ultimate Oscillator Strategy
original_description: The Ultimate Oscillator combines three different timeframes (short, medium, and long) to reduce false signals and volatility. Developed by Larry Williams, it uses weighted buying pressure across multiple periods to identify overbought and oversold conditions with greater accuracy.
description_zh: 终极振荡器结合短、中、长三个不同时间范围，以减少错误信号和波动。该指标由拉里·威廉姆斯开发，使用多个周期的加权买入压力识别超买和超卖状态。作者称这种方法可以提高准确性。

title: Williams %R Reversal Strategy
title_zh: 威廉姆斯 %R 反转策略
original_description: Williams %R (Williams Percent Range) measures overbought and oversold levels by comparing the close to the high-low range over a specified period. This strategy identifies reversal points when the indicator crosses key threshold levels.
description_zh: 威廉姆斯 %R 通过比较收盘价与指定周期内的最高最低价区间来衡量超买和超卖水平。此策略在指标穿越关键阈值时识别反转点。

title: ADX Trend Strength Strategy
original_description: Uses Average Directional Index (ADX) to measure trend strength and Directional Indicators (DI+/DI-) to determine direction. Only trades when ADX confirms strong trending conditions, filtering out weak/choppy markets.
description_zh: 使用平均趋向指数（ADX）衡量趋势强度，并用方向指标 DI+ 和 DI- 判断方向。只有 ADX 确认趋势较强时才交易，以过滤弱势或震荡市场。

title: Chandelier Exit Strategy
original_description: Volatility-based trailing stop system developed by Chuck LeBeau. "Hangs" from the highest high (for longs) or lowest low (for shorts) like a chandelier, using ATR to set the distance. Excellent for riding trends while protecting profits.
description_zh: 由 Chuck LeBeau 开发的波动率跟踪止损系统。它像吊灯一样悬挂在最高价（多头）或最低价（空头）附近，使用 ATR 确定距离。作者认为它适合在跟随趋势时保护利润。

title: Donchian Channel Breakout Strategy
original_description: Classic breakout system based on Richard Donchian's trend-following method (used in the famous Turtle Trading system). Enters when price breaks above/below the highest high/lowest low of the past N periods.
description_zh: 基于理查德·唐奇安趋势跟踪方法的经典突破系统，著名的海龟交易系统也使用了这一方法。当价格突破过去 N 个周期的最高价或最低价时入场。

title: EMA Ribbon (9/21/55) Strategy
original_description: Multi-EMA trend-following system that uses the alignment of three exponential moving averages. Entries are taken when price bounces off the fast EMA while all three EMAs are properly aligned, indicating strong trend momentum.
description_zh: 多 EMA 趋势跟踪系统，使用三条指数移动平均线的排列关系。当三条 EMA 按指定顺序排列、价格从快速 EMA 反弹时入场，表示趋势动量较强。

title: Ichimoku Cloud Strategy
original_description: Comprehensive Japanese trend-following system that provides support/resistance, momentum, and trend direction all in one indicator. The "cloud" (Kumo) acts as dynamic support/resistance, while line crosses signal entries.
description_zh: 一种日本综合趋势跟踪系统，在同一指标中提供支撑/阻力、动量和趋势方向。云层（Kumo）充当动态支撑或阻力，线条交叉提供入场信号。

title: Keltner Channel Trend Strategy
original_description: Volatility-based channel system using EMA and Average True Range (ATR). Identifies trending markets and enters on pullbacks to the channel edges. More adaptive than Donchian Channels due to ATR-based bands.
description_zh: 使用 EMA 和平均真实波幅（ATR）的波动率通道系统。它识别趋势市场，并在价格回撤至通道边缘时入场。作者认为，基于 ATR 的通道使它比唐奇安通道更具适应性。

title: Linear Regression Channel Strategy
original_description: Statistical trend-following system based on linear regression. Uses the best-fit line through recent price action with standard deviation bands. Entries occur on mean-reversion touches within the regression channel while following the overall trend slope.
description_zh: 基于线性回归的统计趋势跟踪系统，使用近期价格走势的最佳拟合线及标准差通道。在跟随整体趋势斜率的同时，当价格触及回归通道边缘并出现均值回归时入场。

title: Parabolic SAR Strategy
original_description: "Stop and Reverse" indicator developed by J. Welles Wilder. Places dots above/below price that act as trailing stops. When price crosses the SAR, it signals a trend reversal and position flip.
description_zh: J. Welles Wilder 开发的“止损并反转”指标。它在价格上方或下方显示作为跟踪止损的点；当价格穿越 SAR 时，提示趋势反转和持仓方向切换。

title: SMA Crossover (50/200) Strategy
original_description: Classic trend-following strategy using Simple Moving Average crossovers. The Golden Cross (fast SMA crosses above slow SMA) signals bullish trends, while the Death Cross (fast crosses below slow) signals bearish trends.
description_zh: 使用简单移动平均线交叉的经典趋势跟踪策略。金叉（快速 SMA 上穿慢速 SMA）表示看涨趋势，死叉（快速 SMA 下穿慢速 SMA）表示看跌趋势。

title: VWAP Bounce Strategy
original_description: Institutional-grade mean reversion within a trend. Uses Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP) as dynamic support/resistance. Enters when price bounces off VWAP bands in the direction of the main trend (determined by 50 EMA).
description_zh: 趋势中的均值回归策略，使用成交量加权平均价格（VWAP）作为动态支撑或阻力。当价格从 VWAP 通道反弹，且方向与 50 EMA 确定的主要趋势一致时入场。
